messages.text:
"Create a beautiful 3D open-world city simulator.

Features:
- A large realistic 3D city.
- Cars that players can drive.
- Shops, houses and skyscrapers.
- NPC characters walking around.
- A day and night cycle.
- Realistic lighting and shadows.
- A third-person player character.
- Smooth mobile touchscreen controls.
- A minimap.
- Different missions and activities.
- Free exploration with no invisible walls.

Make the game visually impressive and optimized for tablets.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
